rows.description: One row per (task type, station, hour bucket). Always present; empty for a window with no data.

hourBucket.description: Start of the UTC hour this row aggregates.

avgClaimToCompleteSeconds.description: Mean seconds from claim to completion, over completions that had a recorded claim.

packagesManifested.description: PackageManifested events attributed to the bucket (SLAM rows only, ADR-0026).

packagesOnTimeToCPT.description: Of those, manifested at or before the originating SLAM task's CPT.

packagesLateToCPT.description: Of those, manifested after the CPT.
